transition_rules.summary: Program transition follows the general transition rule set by FMIPA UGM.
The 2021 curriculum applies to students entering from cohort 2021.
The 2021 curriculum is not mandatory for cohorts 2020 and earlier.
All 2021 curriculum courses are open to active students starting odd semester 2021/2022.
A 2021 mandatory course that was not mandatory in 2016 is not mandatory for cohorts 2020 and earlier.
A 2016 mandatory course that is no longer mandatory in 2021 is not mandatory for cohorts 2020 and earlier.
A 2016 elective that becomes mandatory in 2021 is not mandatory for cohorts 2020 and earlier, but is strongly recommended.
A course mandatory in both curricula remains mandatory for cohorts 2020 and earlier.
When two 2016 courses map to one 2021 course, older cohorts may claim the old pair, the full 2021 course, or the 2021 course plus one old course; they may not claim all three together.
When one 2016 course maps to two 2021 courses, older cohorts may claim either the 2016 course alone or both 2021 courses.
Uncovered transition cases are to be resolved case by case by the student and program administrators.

special_rules.topic: Maximum semester load in the designed schedule
special_rules.summary: The curriculum design discussion uses a maximum of 24 SKS per semester.
At least 144 SKS are required, including required courses and final-project completion.
KKN requires 96 completed SKS, IPK at least 2.00, and no E grade; during regular-semester KKN the student may take either final-project completion or one other course.
The revised schedule marks 8 SKS of KKN-related courses as mandatory: KKN PPM, Komunikasi Masyarakat, and Penerapan Manajemen Pengetahuan.
The PDF states 9 SKS in total: Proposal Skripsi 2, Seminar Skripsi 1, and Skripsi 6.
Students in the international class must complete one listed international-academic activity scheme and provide evidence for graduation.
Courses from other UGM programs may be taken from semester 2; MBKM activity outside UGM may be taken from semester 5.
The PDF says TOEFL at least 500 or AcEPT at least 268 exempts the English course with grade A.
Students who do not meet graduation requirements within the stated maximum of 7 years are considered to have failed and must leave the faculty.
